**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Advance PLAN-adapters-v3 (make brain's three "swappable ports" verified by a real second inhabitant). This session: finish Track A's fixture phase, complete Track C's central claim, and start Track B's foundation — all via SDD (explore→propose→spec→design→tasks→apply), interactive mode, adversarial fresh-context review before every PR, human-gated merges.

## Instructions (durable preferences established this session)
- push+PR without asking; only merge + issue-approval are human-gated ([[workflow/push-pr-authorization]]).
- ALWAYS print a drafted issue's full body inline for review ([[workflow/always-show-ticket-body]]); `gh issue view` fails on this repo (projects-classic GraphQL bug) → fetch `--json ... | node`.
- Never fold new scope into a CLOSED/MERGED issue ([[workflow/no-fold-into-closed-issue]]).
- tripwire-as-test: encode "revisit when Y happens" caveats as a scanning test, not a comment ([[workflow/tripwire-as-test]]).
- env limits ≠ world properties: scope sandbox limits honestly ([[env-limits-not-world-properties]]).
- Verify+cite measurements myself before citing a reviewer's numbers.
- Foundational slices get owner pins at proposal/design — expect forks.

## Discoveries
- Track A fixture phase COMPLETE: A2 #231, A3 #239 (PRs #240/#241/#242/#243), A4 #244 (PR #245) — all merged to feature/v2.0.0.
- Track C n=2 DEMONSTRATED: C3 #246 (PR #248 merged) — plainfiles backend + two-direction round-trip + executable durability. Central claim complete.
- Track B REFRAMED by measurement (#584/#585): the SDD_HARNESS port is 1 op (`init`) BY DESIGN; artifacts are harness-neutral. Reframe = design truth, not bug → the pure-evaluator+thin-wrapper pattern of Track A applied to the executor.
- Latent bugs found+filed: #247 (C4 chunk migration incomplete — brain-audit/brain-check/release still on readChunkObservations); #249 (new-change scaffolded only 3/4 artifacts — fixed in PR #251).
- Recurring: engram dirties tracked `.memory/*.jsonl` → `git restore .memory/` before every branch checkout.

## Accomplished
- A3 chain (3 PRs, CP-A3a approved): labelEvents/prView/mrCreate GitLab verbs + closed the m3 "CI fetch ignores runtime provider" CLASS (4 sites) + contract suite + 3-source drift-guard.
- A4 (PR #245, CP-A4a): GitLab rung-1 as 3 honest sub-gates (pipelineMustSucceed load-bearing) + door-typed provenance.
- C3 (PR #248, CP-C3): plainfiles backend, measured spoof-resistant provenance, doc-scan tripwire.
- B-track: measured the harness contract; drafted+approved B0 #250 with 3 pins (legacy-accepted spec variant [15 flat/10 nested], grandfather-don't-rewrite-history [12 legacy dirs], plain=real backend); redefined B2 = Antigravity baptism (candidate #247), B3 deferred.
- Micro-fix #251 (spec.md scaffold) open.

## Next Steps
- **#250 B0 awaits status:approved** → then run SDD. Owner predicts forks at proposal + design (the normative port wording; the exact grandfather mechanism). HARD STOP at CP-B0 with the full package: ADR draft (must cite the pure-evaluator/thin-wrapper analogy) + normative sdd-layout.md + the REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS accessor with its drift-guard + a WORKING SDD_HARNESS=plain + the B1 worklist (6 sites).
- Merge #251; approve #247 when scheduling.
- Then B1 → B2 (Antigravity baptism). Two external keys remain: the SCIT mirror endpoint (unblocks the whole SCIT bundle: CP-A2b smoke + CP-A3b + recorder-gitlab), and the owner's baptism call (#247 for Antigravity).

## Relevant Files
- openspec/changes/issue-{239-a3,231-a2,244-a4,246-c3}-*/ — the merged slices + their checkpoint reports.
- brain/scripts/memory/backends/plainfiles.mjs — C3's second backend.
- brain/scripts/harness/{cli.mjs,backends/gentle-ai.mjs} + brain/core/methodology/harness-contract.md — B0's targets (measured inventory in engram #584).
- brain/scripts/new-change.mjs — #251 micro-fix (4-artifact scaffold).
- PLAN-adapters-v3 next-slice state: engram [[plan-adapters-v3/next-slice]]; B-track: [[sdd/track-b/reframe]], [[sdd/issue-250-b0/constraints]].
